payload.name: Superhuman Mail
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect Superhuman Mail to build powerful workflows across Gmail, Outlook, and Google Calendar. Search your inbox and calendar, summarize what matters, draft AI replies in your voice, check read statuses, prepare for your day, send emails or schedule events, and manage multiple Gmail and Outlook accounts.
payload.longDescription: 连接 Superhuman Mail，在 Gmail、Outlook 和 Google Calendar 之间构建强大的工作流程。搜索收件箱和日历、总结重要内容、以你的口吻拟写 AI 回复、查看已读状态、为一天的安排做准备、发送邮件或安排活动，并管理多个 Gmail 和 Outlook 账户。

payload.name: Werify
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Werify gives users their own WhatsApp archive inside ChatGPT — conversations they imported from a chat export or captured from a number they connected. They can find a conversation, read its transcript a page at a time (voice notes included, as text), search inside it and list its attachments. With the user's approval it can also act: send one confirmed text message, connect a WhatsApp number by pairing code, preview how far back a chat's earlier history reaches and how much of it each window would bring in, start or stop capture, and bring in one window the user explicitly approved. Werify is prepaid and the account is funded on werify.app; nothing is sold, priced or paid for through this app.
payload.longDescription: Werify在ChatGPT内为用户创建专属的WhatsApp归档——包含用户从聊天导出文件中导入的对话，或通过连接的号码捕获的对话。用户可以查找特定对话，逐页查看文字记录（含语音备忘录的文本形式），在对话内搜索内容并查看附件列表。在获得用户授权后，该工具还可执行操作：发送一条确认过的短信、通过配对码连接WhatsApp号码、预览聊天历史可追溯的范围及各窗口可加载的内容、启动或停止捕获功能，并导入用户明确批准的单个窗口内容。Werify采用预付费模式，账户资金通过werify.app充值；该应用内不涉及任何商品销售、定价或支付流程。

payload.name: Teams

payload.longDescription: Microsoft Teams 办公聊天与协作：搜索消息、总结讨论串、发送回复并管理 Planner 任务。

payload.name: Hostinger Mail
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Hostinger Mail helps users discover mailbox operations, inspect mailboxes and folders, read or search messages, send email, and manage message or webhook state in their authenticated Hostinger Mail account through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: 通过 ChatGPT，用户可以在经过身份验证的 Hostinger Mail 账号中查找邮箱操作、检查邮箱和文件夹、阅读或搜索邮件、发送电子邮件，以及管理邮件或 webhook 状态。

payload.name: Zoom
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Zoom connects Codex to Zoom meeting context through the Zoom app connector and provides developer workflows for planning, building, debugging, and reviewing Zoom integrations across APIs, SDKs, webhooks, WebSockets, bots, and automation use cases.
payload.longDescription: Zoom 通过 Zoom 应用连接器将 Zoom 会议背景连接到 Codex，并为规划、构建、调试和审核 Zoom 集成提供开发工作流，涵盖 API、SDK、webhook、WebSocket、机器人和自动化场景。

payload.name: Mailopoly Inbox
payload.description: 搜索并发送邮件和消息
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Mailopoly brings supported email accounts and messaging services into one unified inbox. Connect Gmail, Google Workspace, Outlook, Microsoft 365, iCloud Mail, Yahoo Mail, or a compatible IMAP mailbox. Search across connected accounts, read complete emails and attachment text, catch up on new mail, and draft or send email from a connected account.

Mailopoly analyzes connected email to surface priorities and extract tasks, meetings and events, invoices and bills with amounts and due dates, and parcel deliveries. Organize messages with smart lists, troubleshoot syncing and reconnection, and receive an optional daily briefing.

Mailopoly also supports authorized connections to Slack, Microsoft Teams, WhatsApp, TikTok, Facebook, and Instagram. Messages from connected services appear alongside email, can be searched in the same inbox, and can be answered in their original service.

A Mailopoly account is required.
payload.longDescription:
Mailopoly 将支持的电子邮件账户和消息服务整合到一个统一收件箱中。连接 Gmail、Google Workspace、Outlook、Microsoft 365、iCloud Mail、Yahoo Mail 或兼容的 IMAP 邮箱。搜索已连接账户、阅读完整邮件和附件文本、查看新邮件，也可以从已连接账户起草或发送邮件。

Mailopoly 会分析已连接的邮件，提取优先事项、任务、会议和活动、带金额与到期日的发票和账单，以及包裹配送信息。你可以通过智能列表整理消息、排查同步和重新连接问题，并选择接收每日简报。

Mailopoly 还支持授权连接 Slack、Microsoft Teams、WhatsApp、TikTok、Facebook 和 Instagram。来自已连接服务的消息会与电子邮件一起显示，可在同一收件箱中搜索，并能在原服务中回复。

需要 Mailopoly 账户。

payload.name: Brevo
payload.description: 访问营销活动与联系人
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect Brevo to analyze email campaign performance and A/B test results, look up contacts, and explore audience segments in plain language, all without leaving your conversation. ChatGPT can also generate HTML email templates, draft email campaigns, and draft SMS campaigns, saved directly to your Brevo account for you to review before sending. ChatGPT will never send or schedule email campaigns, and will never delete anything on your behalf. Available on all Brevo plans.
payload.longDescription: 连接 Brevo 后，你可以用日常语言分析电子邮件营销活动的表现和 A/B 测试结果、查找联系人并探索受众细分，全程无需离开当前对话。ChatGPT 还可以生成 HTML 邮件模板、起草电子邮件营销活动和 SMS 营销活动，并直接保存到你的 Brevo 账户，供你审核后再发送。ChatGPT 绝不会代你发送或安排电子邮件营销活动，也不会代你删除任何内容。所有 Brevo 套餐均可使用。

payload.name: Rhythm AI Personality Tuner
payload.description: 调整 ChatGPT 与你交谈的方式
payload.summaryOriginal: Tune how ChatGPT talks to you
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Everyone has a Rhythm — a way they like to be talked to.

Rhythm AI Personality Tuner lets you shape ChatGPT's voice to match yours. Five quick cards, fifteen sliders, about a minute: choose how warm or professional it should feel, how direct, how much detail, whether it should challenge your thinking or validate first, hold you accountable or keep things gentle. When you finish, ChatGPT starts speaking your rhythm right there in the conversation — and a before-and-after preview shows you the difference.

Prefer it straight? Your rhythm can say so. Turn down the praise, turn up the pushback, and get answers that tell you what you need to hear — not just what you want to hear.

Your rhythm tunes fifteen dimensions of how ChatGPT communicates, including the ones that matter when a conversation gets personal: emotional awareness, encouragement, and the kind of support you actually want in the moment.

Save your rhythm with a free Rhythm account to keep it. It follows you into new conversations — just @-mention Rhythm to bring it along — and into the Rhythm app, a space to reflect, process, and grow at your own pace. Tune it in either place; it stays in sync.
payload.longDescription:
每个人都有自己的 Rhythm——也就是喜欢别人如何与自己交谈。

Rhythm AI Personality Tuner 可让你调整 ChatGPT 的表达方式，使其符合你的偏好。通过五张快速卡片和十五个滑块，约一分钟即可设置：希望语气多温暖或多专业、表达多直接、细节多丰富、是挑战你的想法还是先表示认同、是督促你负责还是语气温和。完成后，ChatGPT 会立即在当前对话中按照你的节奏表达，并通过前后对比预览展示差异。

喜欢直言不讳？你的 Rhythm 可以体现这一点。减少夸赞、增加质疑，让回答告诉你需要听到的内容，而不只是你想听的内容。

你的 Rhythm 可调整 ChatGPT 沟通方式的十五个维度，包括在私人话题对话中至关重要的方面：情绪觉察、鼓励方式，以及你当下真正需要的支持类型。

创建免费的 Rhythm 账户即可保存你的 Rhythm。它会随你进入新的对话——只需提及 @Rhythm 即可调用——也会同步到 Rhythm 应用中；在那里你可以按自己的节奏反思、整理思绪并成长。无论在哪一处调整，都会保持同步。

payload.name: AI Roleplay Chat Simulator
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Talk to anyone, anytime, without the pressure.

This app lets you role play conversations with smart AI people so you can practice before real life.

Pick who you want to talk to, choose a situation, and start chatting. Practice a job interview, a first date, a hard talk with a friend, a meeting with your boss, small talk, customer service, school, travel, or almost any other conversation. The AI answers like a real person and keeps the conversation going. You can try again, change your words, and build confidence one chat at a time.

Talking to people is not always easy. Sometimes you do not know what to say. Sometimes you want to practice before an important moment. This app gives you a safe place to learn. There is no need to feel rushed. You can stop, start again, or try a different answer whenever you want. Every conversation is a chance to learn something new.

Choose from many different people and situations. Talk to a friendly coworker, a teacher, a customer, a neighbor, a family member, a hiring manager, a classmate, a travel guide, a doctor, or create your own character. You can make conversations easy, medium, or hard. You decide how the other person acts. They can be kind, serious, funny, shy, calm, excited, or challenging. Every chat feels fresh because the AI responds to what you say.

Practice for real life in a simple way. Get ready for interviews by answering common questions. Rehearse speeches and presentations. Learn how to ask for help. Practice saying no in a kind way. Prepare for school, work, meetings, travel, shopping, or everyday conversations. Try difficult talks before they happen so you feel more ready when the real moment comes.

Learning is easier when you can practice again and again. If you do not like your answer, try another one. See how different words can change the conversation. Explore different paths and discover new ways to communicate. Every practice session helps you become more comfortable speaking with other people.

The app is great for students, professionals, language learners, job seekers, teachers, parents, travelers, and anyone who wants to become a better communicator. Whether you are preparing for something important or simply want to improve your everyday conversation skills, there is always something new to practice.

You can create your own role play ideas too. Type in a situation, describe the person you want to talk with, and let the AI build a conversation just for you. Make fun stories, serious talks, fantasy adventures, business meetings, classroom lessons, or everyday life scenes. The possibilities are almost endless.

The AI listens to what you say and answers naturally. Each conversation changes based on your choices, making every session feel unique. Explore different ideas, ask questions, solve problems together, or simply enjoy a friendly chat. The more you practice, the more comfortable speaking can become.

Simple to use and easy to enjoy, this app is made for anyone who wants to practice conversations in a safe and private space. Open the app, choose a person, start talking, and learn by doing. Build confidence, improve communication, explore new situations, and get ready for real conversations one message at a time. Whether your goal is better social skills, stronger communication, interview success, language practice, or everyday confidence, this app helps you practice, learn, and grow through natural AI role play conversations whenever you are ready.
payload.longDescription:
随时与任何人交谈，无需承受压力。

这款应用让你与智能 AI 人物进行角色扮演对话，在实际交流前先练习。

选择想交谈的对象和情境，开始聊天。练习求职面试、初次约会、与朋友的艰难谈话、与上司开会、闲聊、客户服务、学校、旅行，或几乎任何其他对话。AI 像真人一样回应，让对话持续下去。你可以重新尝试、调整措辞，通过一次次聊天建立信心。

与人交谈并不总是容易。有时你不知道该说什么，有时你想在重要时刻到来前先练习。这款应用为你提供安全的学习空间，无需感到仓促。你可以随时停止、重新开始或尝试不同的回答。每次对话都是学习新东西的机会。

从众多人物和情境中选择。与友善的同事、老师、客户、邻居、家人、招聘经理、同学、导游、医生交谈，或创建自己的角色。你可以将对话设为简单、中等或困难。由你决定对方的表现：亲切、严肃、幽默、害羞、平静、兴奋或富有挑战性。AI 会根据你说的话回应，因此每次聊天都有新鲜感。

用简单的方式练习真实生活中的交流。回答常见问题，为面试做好准备。排练演讲和演示。学习如何请求帮助，练习如何友善地拒绝。为学校、工作、会议、旅行、购物或日常对话做好准备。在艰难谈话发生之前先试一试，让你在真正面对时更有准备。

反复练习让学习更容易。如果不满意自己的回答，就换一种。看看不同措辞如何改变对话。探索不同的发展方向，发现新的沟通方式。每次练习都能帮助你更自在地与他人交谈。

这款应用适合学生、专业人士、语言学习者、求职者、教师、家长、旅行者，以及任何想提高沟通能力的人。无论你在为重要事情做准备，还是只想改善日常会话技巧，总有新的内容可以练习。

你也可以创建自己的角色扮演创意。输入情境，描述想与之交谈的人，让 AI 为你构建专属对话。创作有趣的故事、严肃的谈话、奇幻冒险、商务会议、课堂教学或日常生活场景。可能性几乎无穷无尽。

AI 会听取你说的话并自然回应。每次对话都会根据你的选择变化，让每次练习都独一无二。探索不同想法、提出问题、共同解决问题，或只是享受友好的聊天。练习越多，交谈就能越自在。

这款应用简单易用、轻松有趣，面向所有想在安全、私密空间中练习对话的人。打开应用，选择人物，开始交谈，在实践中学习。通过一条条消息建立信心、改善沟通、探索新情境，为真实对话做好准备。无论目标是提升社交技能、增强沟通能力、成功面试、练习语言还是建立日常自信，这款应用都能让你在准备好时，通过自然的 AI 角色扮演对话练习、学习和成长。

payload.name: Prezi
payload.description: 将幻灯片变成交互式演示文稿
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Prezi's plugin takes slides you already have, made in ChatGPT, generated in another tool, or uploaded as a PowerPoint or PDF, and places them on Prezi's open, zoomable canvas, turning a flat deck into a highly visual, interactive presentation. You get a full suite of presentation, engagement, and sharing tools that go beyond static slides: engagement features like polls, quizzes, and Q&A help you teach, sell, and give your ideas traction long after the slides are made.

Already have a deck? Bring it in. Or describe a topic and Prezi will build one for you, with an inline animated preview as it renders. Revise in place: add, edit, reorder, or remove slides and switch themes.

Present and share your way:
Present live with your content next to you in an interactive video with Newscaster mode
Share and export it as a narrated video or a podcast
Share one interactive link where your audience can answer polls and quizzes, submit and upvote questions, and respond to word clouds live or on their own time
Export to PDF, PowerPoint, or SCORM

Every deck lands in your own Prezi account. New decks are private on paid plans and public on free plans. A public deck can be opened by anyone with its link; a private deck has no share link. Changing a deck's visibility requires a paid plan. Signing in with your Prezi account is required.

Sample prompts:
@Prezi create an interactive lesson about [topic] for [audience]. Include an opening poll, a visual explanation, a demonstration, two knowledge checks, a word cloud, and a final quiz.
@Prezi turn the attached presentation into a zoomable, interactive presentation for [audience]. Create a clear presentation path and add an opening poll, a word cloud after [section], a moderated Q&A, a five-question quiz, and a feedback activity.
@Prezi review this presentation and add audience activities in the most useful places. Include an opening poll, a midpoint word cloud, a moderated Q&A, a five-question closing quiz, and a feedback form.
payload.longDescription:
Prezi 插件可将你已有的幻灯片（在 ChatGPT 中制作、由其他工具生成，或作为 PowerPoint 或 PDF 上传）放到 Prezi 开放且可缩放的画布上，把平面演示文稿变成视觉效果丰富、可交互的演示体验。它提供完整的演示、互动和分享工具，超越静态幻灯片：投票、测验和问答等互动功能可帮助你教学、销售，并让创意在演示结束后继续发挥影响。

已有演示文稿？直接导入。也可以描述主题，让 Prezi 为你制作，并在生成过程中提供内嵌动画预览。可直接在原稿中修改：添加、编辑、重新排序或删除幻灯片，也可切换主题。

按你的方式演示和分享：
开启实时演示，让内容与你并列显示在带有 Newscaster 模式的互动视频中
分享并导出为配音视频或播客
分享一个互动链接，让观众参与投票和测验、提交问题并为问题点赞，还可实时或自行选择时间回应文字云
导出为 PDF、PowerPoint 或 SCORM

每份演示文稿都会保存到你自己的 Prezi 账户。付费方案中新建的演示文稿默认为私密，免费方案中新建的演示文稿默认为公开。任何人都可以通过链接打开公开演示文稿；私密演示文稿没有分享链接。更改演示文稿的可见性需要付费方案。必须使用 Prezi 账户登录。

示例提示：
@Prezi 为 [受众] 创建关于 [主题] 的互动课程。加入开场投票、可视化讲解、演示、两次知识检查、文字云和最终测验。
@Prezi 将附件中的演示文稿改造成面向 [受众] 的可缩放互动演示。设计清晰的演示路径，并加入开场投票、[章节] 之后的文字云、主持式问答、五题测验和反馈活动。
@Prezi 审阅此演示文稿，并在最合适的位置加入观众互动活动。包括开场投票、中段文字云、主持式问答、五题结尾测验和反馈表单。

payload.name: Inkbox
payload.description: 为 AI 提供邮件、电话和 iMessage
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Inkbox gives an AI assistant its own communication identity: an email address, a phone number, SMS and iMessage, and voice calls, reachable by humans and other agents alike. The assistant reads and sends from its own inbox, handles its own calls and texts, and keeps a contact book and notes that carry context between conversations. Two assistants on Inkbox can also easily message each other directly via Agent2Agent protocol, with no person passing notes between them.

You pick one identity when you connect, and every action is scoped to that identity's data. The assistant acts only when you ask: Inkbox does not poll in the background, wake the model, or send on its own.

Phone numbers are currently available in the United States. Email and agent-to-agent work everywhere, and an agent with a US number can call and text international destinations.
payload.longDescription:
Inkbox 为 AI 助手提供独立通信身份：电子邮件地址、电话号码、短信和 iMessage，以及语音通话；人类和其他智能体都可以联系到它。助手可以从自己的收件箱读取和发送消息、处理自己的通话和短信，并维护联系人簿和备注，让上下文延续到后续对话。使用 Inkbox 的两个助手也可以通过 Agent2Agent 协议直接互发消息，无需他人转述。

连接时由你选择一个身份，所有操作都限定在该身份的数据范围内。助手只会在你提出请求时行动：Inkbox 不会在后台轮询、唤醒模型或自行发送消息。

目前电话号码仅在美国提供。电子邮件和智能体之间的通信可在全球使用；拥有美国号码的智能体可拨打国际电话并向国际号码发送短信。

payload.name: Send Postcard
payload.description: 设计并邮寄真实明信片
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Send Postcard lets you design a physical postcard and send it anywhere in the world, all from within a conversation. Open the built-in editor to compose your message and choose your image, then place an order through a secure Stripe checkout. Once payment is confirmed, the order goes straight to a print-and-mail partner who handles printing, addressing, and delivery. You get a live status update at each stage: pending, shipped, refunded, or expired. People love it for birthday greetings, travel notes, thank-you cards, and staying in touch with family without leaving the chat. This app does not cover digital greeting cards, email campaigns, gift wrapping, merchandise printing, poster or canvas orders, package shipping, or any intent beyond designing and mailing a standard physical postcard.
payload.longDescription: Send Postcard 让你可以在对话中设计实体明信片并寄往世界各地。打开内置编辑器撰写留言并选择图片，然后通过安全的 Stripe 结账流程下单。确认付款后，订单会直接发送给负责打印、填写地址和投递的印刷邮寄合作方。每个阶段都会提供实时状态更新：待处理、已寄出、已退款或已过期。人们常用它寄送生日祝福、旅行问候和感谢卡，也可以在不离开聊天的情况下与家人保持联系。此应用不支持数字贺卡、电子邮件营销活动、礼品包装、商品印刷、海报或画布订单、包裹寄送，也不处理设计和邮寄标准实体明信片以外的需求。

payload.name: TIM Brasil
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Compare planos e encontre o melhor pra você
payload.longDescription: 比较套餐，找到最适合你的方案

payload.name: Turnfeed
payload.description: 在 ChatGPT 中使用社交动态
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Turnfeed is a public social feed inside ChatGPT. See recent posts, open full conversations, and find people without signing in. Connect your Turnfeed identity to post, reply, like, follow, update your profile, and use safety controls. Before anything changes, ChatGPT shows the action for approval.
payload.longDescription: Turnfeed 是 ChatGPT 内的公开社交动态。无需登录即可查看最新帖子、打开完整对话并查找用户。连接你的 Turnfeed 身份后，可发布帖子、回复、点赞、关注、更新个人资料并使用安全控制。在任何内容发生变更前，ChatGPT 都会显示操作供你批准。

payload.name: Kepler
payload.description: 保存链接并构建 AI 记忆
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Kepler gives ChatGPT secure access to the personal and team knowledge you have saved across the web — links, pages, videos, images, notes, annotations, and references.

Instead of re-explaining your research in every conversation, ChatGPT can search your Kepler Spaces and retrieve the right context at the right time. Kepler extracts memory not only from page text, but also from rich content such as videos and images, so results include useful context rather than just a URL and title.

Organize saved knowledge into personal or shared Spaces, collaborate with teammates through annotations and notes, and let ChatGPT draw on that collective knowledge whenever you need it.
payload.longDescription:
Kepler 为 ChatGPT 安全提供对你在网络上保存的个人和团队知识的访问，包括链接、页面、视频、图片、笔记、批注和参考资料。

你无需在每次对话中重新解释研究内容，ChatGPT 可以搜索你的 Kepler Spaces，并在合适时机取回相关上下文。Kepler 不仅从网页文本中提取记忆，也会处理视频和图片等丰富内容，因此结果会包含有用上下文，而不只是 URL 和标题。

将已保存的知识整理到个人或共享 Spaces 中，通过批注和笔记与队友协作，并在需要时让 ChatGPT 运用团队共同积累的知识。

payload.name: AT&T
payload.description: 选购互联网与无线通信服务
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AT&T Products provides an integrated conversational experience that enables users to verify home internet availability, evaluate internet and wireless offerings, explore devices and service plans, locate AT&T stores, manage shopping carts, and transition seamlessly to AT&T checkout.
payload.longDescription: AT&T Products 提供一体化对话体验，支持用户查询家庭互联网服务是否覆盖其地址、比较互联网和无线通信服务、了解设备及服务套餐、查找 AT&T 门店、管理购物车，并顺畅进入 AT&T 结账流程。

payload.name: Textmagic
payload.description: 发送短信并管理联系人
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Textmagic brings business SMS into your AI assistant. Send and schedule text messages, preview cost and recipients before sending, track delivery, and read incoming replies without leaving the chat. Manage your address book too: search contacts, create and update them, organize lists and tags. Every send is previewed and confirmed before it goes out, and messaging always respects your account balance and permissions. Ideal for appointment reminders, alerts, follow-ups and quick customer replies.
payload.longDescription: Textmagic 将企业短信功能带入你的 AI 助手。无需离开聊天即可发送和安排短信、在发送前预览费用和收件人、跟踪送达情况并阅读收到的回复。你还可以管理通讯录：搜索联系人、创建和更新联系人，并整理列表和标签。每次发送都会先预览并确认，且消息操作始终遵循你的账户余额和权限。适用于预约提醒、警报、后续跟进和快速回复客户。

payload.name: Fyxer
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Fyxer for ChatGPT lets you write emails that sound like you, right from the chat. Fyxer learns your writing style from past emails and uses context from your calendar and meeting notes to create personalized email drafts. Just describe what you want to say and get a polished email ready to review and send.
payload.longDescription: Fyxer for ChatGPT 让你直接在聊天中撰写符合自己语气的邮件。Fyxer 会从过去的邮件中学习你的写作风格，并利用日历和会议记录中的上下文生成个性化邮件草稿。只需描述你想表达的内容，即可获得一封润色完成、可供审核和发送的邮件。

payload.name: NoPressure
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
NoPressure is a communication-skills practice for the workplace. It turns a hard conversation into a live voice roleplay you can rehearse before the real one: delivering critical feedback, saying no to a request, handling a performance review, pushing back on a stakeholder, negotiating a raise, running a first 1:1 with a new team.

Describe the situation once — who the other person is, where they stand, and what makes it hard. ChatGPT can assemble that brief from what is already in the conversation, including anything you have brought in from the other tools you use, so the character is built on the real people and the real stakes instead of a generic template. NoPressure sees only the brief it is handed: it has no access to your calendar, mail, or documents. From that brief, it generates the character, a scene image, and a voice, then shows a start card in the chat. Pressing Start opens the voice call in the NoPressure web app, where you speak out loud with someone who holds their own position and pushes back.

When the session ends, the debrief comes back to the card: the key insight, how you handled the core challenge, and where to focus next. Send it into the chat, with the transcript of what was said, and work through it with ChatGPT. Simulations are reusable, so you can run one again and compare the attempt against an earlier try, or edit its title, card description, and character first. Each one lives in your own private NoPressure workspace.
payload.longDescription:
NoPressure 是一款面向职场的沟通技能练习工具。它能将棘手的对话变成实时语音角色扮演，让你在正式沟通前进行排练：给出严厉反馈、拒绝请求、应对绩效评估、向利益相关方提出异议、协商加薪，或与新团队成员进行首次 1:1 沟通。

只需描述一次情境——对方是谁、对方的立场，以及难点在哪里。ChatGPT 可以根据当前对话中的已有信息整理这份简报，包括你从其他工具带入的内容，让角色以真实人物和真实利害关系为基础，而非通用模板。NoPressure 只能看到收到的简报：它无法访问你的日历、邮件或文档。根据简报，它会生成角色、场景图片和语音，然后在聊天中显示开始卡片。点击 Start 会在 NoPressure Web 应用中开启语音通话，你可以与一位坚持自身立场并会提出反驳的角色直接对话。

会话结束后，复盘内容会返回卡片，包括关键洞见、你应对核心挑战的方式，以及下一步应关注的方面。你可以将复盘内容及对话转录发送到聊天中，继续与 ChatGPT 讨论。模拟情境可重复使用，因此你可以重新练习并与先前尝试比较，也可以先编辑标题、卡片描述和角色。每个情境都保存在你自己的 NoPressure 私人工作区中。

payload.name: RingCentral Chat
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: RingCentral Chat helps you manage your RingCentral Team Chat collaboration directly from ChatGPT. Catch up on recent conversations, read posts and shared files, review notes, tasks, and events, find coworkers, and inspect teams without jumping between tools. It is designed for RingCentral users who want a faster way to stay informed and collaborate with their teams. Ask natural questions like “What did I miss in the launch chat?”, “Show my incomplete tasks,” or “Find the file Alex shared,” and RingCentral Chat can retrieve the relevant information from your RingCentral account. When you are ready to take action, it can also help send or update posts, create tasks and Adaptive Cards, manage teams, and configure incoming webhooks. RingCentral Chat is focused on Team Chat collaboration, not SMS, phone calls, voicemail, email, account administration, or user provisioning. This beta is an early step toward bringing RingCentral collaboration into the AI tools people use every day, and the experience will continue to improve with feedback.
payload.longDescription: RingCentral Chat 帮助你直接通过 ChatGPT 管理 RingCentral Team Chat 协作。快速了解近期对话、阅读帖子和共享文件、查看笔记、任务和活动、查找同事并检查团队，无需在工具间来回切换。它专为希望更快掌握信息并与团队协作的 RingCentral 用户设计。你可以自然地询问：“What did I miss in the launch chat?”、“Show my incomplete tasks”或“Find the file Alex shared”，RingCentral Chat 就能从你的 RingCentral 账户中检索相关信息。准备采取行动时，它还可以帮助发送或更新帖子、创建任务和 Adaptive Cards、管理团队以及配置传入 webhook。RingCentral Chat 专注于 Team Chat 协作，不处理 SMS、电话、语音信箱、电子邮件、账户管理或用户配置。此测试版是将 RingCentral 协作带入人们日常 AI 工具的初步尝试，产品体验会持续根据反馈改进。

payload.name: Breakreach
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Breakreach is a social media scheduler inside ChatGPT: schedule and post to all your social accounts, answer comments and DMs, and track your analytics from a conversation.

Plan and publish
Write posts in chat and schedule them on Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, X (Twitter), YouTube, Facebook, Threads, Pinterest, Bluesky, Reddit, Telegram and Discord: at a time you choose, at the next free slot of your posting schedule, or right away. Save drafts to finish in Breakreach, edit or reschedule any post that hasn't gone out yet, and retry a failed one. Platform options are built in: TikTok privacy, YouTube title and visibility, Instagram stories, Pinterest boards, Reddit subreddits and flairs.

Manage your community
Read the latest comments on your Instagram, Facebook, Threads and YouTube posts and the replies to your X posts in one place. Reply to them, hide spam on Instagram, Facebook and Threads, or delete comments on Instagram and Facebook. Read and answer your direct messages on Instagram, Facebook Messenger and X.

Understand what works
Social media analytics in plain language: views, likes, comments, shares and engagement rate for every post over up to a year on Instagram, Facebook, Threads, X, YouTube and Bluesky, including posts you didn't publish with Breakreach. Get followers and 28-day views and reach for every account, TikTok and Pinterest included, daily account trends, and the full insights of a single post (reach, saves, watch time, retention) compared with your average post.

Getting started
You need a Breakreach account with an active plan or trial. Connect your social accounts once in Breakreach, then connect Breakreach in ChatGPT and sign in: authentication is OAuth, with no API key to copy.
payload.longDescription:
Breakreach是内置在ChatGPT中的社交媒体调度器：可安排并发布到所有社交媒体账号，回复评论和私信，并从对话中跟踪分析数据。

计划与发布
在聊天中撰写帖子并安排在Instagram、TikTok、LinkedIn、X（Twitter）、YouTube、Facebook、Threads、Pinterest、Bluesky、Reddit、Telegram和Discord发布：可在您选择的时间、发布日程的下一个空闲时段，或立即发布。
保存草稿以在Breakreach中完成，编辑或重新安排尚未发布的任何帖子，并重试失败的帖子。
平台选项已内置：TikTok隐私设置、YouTube标题和可见性、Instagram故事、Pinterest画板、Reddit子版块和表情标签。

管理您的社区
在一个界面中查看Instagram、Facebook、Threads和YouTube帖子的最新评论，以及X帖子的回复。
回复这些评论，在Instagram、Facebook和Threads隐藏垃圾评论，或删除Instagram和Facebook的评论。
查看并回复Instagram、Facebook Messenger和X的私信。

了解哪些内容有效
用通俗语言呈现的社交媒体分析数据：可查看Instagram、Facebook、Threads、X、YouTube和Bluesky上每篇帖子的浏览量、点赞数、评论数、分享数和互动率（最长追溯一年），包括未通过Breakreach发布的帖子。
获取每个账号（含TikTok和Pinterest）的粉丝数、28天内浏览量和覆盖量、每日账号趋势，以及单篇帖子的完整洞察数据（覆盖量、保存数、观看时长、留存率）与平均帖子的对比。

开始使用
您需要拥有一个具有有效计划或试用期的Breakreach账户。
首次在Breakreach中连接您的社交媒体账号，然后在ChatGPT中连接Breakreach并登录：采用OAuth认证方式，无需复制API密钥。

payload.name: Klaxoon
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Klaxoon MCP helps users read, summarize, organize, and update Klaxoon whiteboards, helping teams prepare workshops, structure ideas, and turn board content into actionable outputs through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Klaxoon MCP 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 阅读、总结、整理和更新 Klaxoon 白板，协助团队准备工作坊、梳理想法，并将白板内容转化为可执行成果。

payload.name: Publora
payload.description: 发布到 10 个社交网络
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Publora lets ChatGPT publish and schedule your social media posts across ten networks: LinkedIn, X, Instagram, Threads, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, Bluesky, Mastodon and Telegram.

Connect your accounts once, then work in plain language. Ask for a post to be drafted and kept as a draft for you to approve, attach an image or video, schedule it for a specific time, or check what is already queued. Publora handles each network's own rules, so you don't have to think about character limits, media requirements or threading.

On LinkedIn it can also comment, react and reshare from the same conversation.

You need a Publora account with at least one connected social account. The free plan works.
payload.longDescription:
Publora 可让 ChatGPT 在十个社交网络上发布和安排社交媒体帖子：LinkedIn、X、Instagram、Threads、TikTok、YouTube、Facebook、Bluesky、Mastodon 和 Telegram。

只需连接一次账户，之后即可使用日常语言操作。你可以要求起草帖子并将其保留为草稿供你批准、附加图片或视频、安排在指定时间发布，或查看当前排队中的内容。Publora 会处理每个网络各自的规则，因此你无需操心字符数限制、媒体要求或串帖。

在 LinkedIn 上，你还可以在同一对话中发表评论、作出回应和转发。

你需要拥有 Publora 账户，并至少连接一个社交账户。免费方案也可使用。

payload.name: Speko
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Speko gives ChatGPT a phone line. Describe the call you want — confirm an appointment, chase a quote, ask a clinic which insurance it takes — and Speko dials the number with a voice agent, stays on the line, and hands back a full transcript and a recording when it ends. Every call opens by saying it is an AI. Before dialing a real person you can rehearse the whole conversation against a synthetic caller and read that transcript first. Speko also transcribes audio from a link, including its own call recordings, and speaks text back in hundreds of voices and languages ChatGPT cannot produce itself.
payload.longDescription: Speko 为 ChatGPT 提供电话线路。描述你希望拨打的电话——确认预约、跟进报价，或询问诊所接受哪些保险——Speko 就会通过语音智能体拨打号码、保持通话，并在结束后提供完整文字记录和录音。每次通话开始时都会说明自己是 AI。拨打真实人员之前，你可以先与合成来电者演练整个对话，并阅读演练记录。Speko 还可以转录链接中的音频（包括其自身通话录音），并以 ChatGPT 本身无法生成的数百种声音和语言朗读文本。

payload.name: Geekbot
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Run async standups, team updates, check-ins, polls, surveys, and get progress summaries in Slack and Microsoft Teams.

Geekbot is an assistant for Slack and Microsoft Teams that helps remote and hybrid teams automate standups, daily updates, team check-ins, status reports and any kind of polls or surveys (eg employee feedback, developer pulse, leadership trust and more).

Connect Geekbot to ChatGPT to submit standup reports, answer daily check-ins, create polls and surveys, review team updates, read status reports and summarize weekly recaps.

Geekbot helps engineering managers, people/HR managers, team leads, and remote teams ask questions like 'Collect team blockers', 'Monitor employee engagement', 'Run a pulse survey', 'Submit my daily update' and more.

This feature requires a Geekbot paid plan.
payload.longDescription:
在 Slack 和 Microsoft Teams 中开展异步站会、团队动态更新、签到、投票和调查，并获取进度摘要。

Geekbot 是面向 Slack 和 Microsoft Teams 的助手，可帮助远程和混合办公团队自动处理站会、每日更新、团队签到、状态报告以及各种投票或调查（例如员工反馈、开发者状态调查、领导层信任度等）。

将 Geekbot 连接到 ChatGPT，即可提交站会报告、回答每日签到问题、创建投票和调查、查看团队更新、阅读状态报告并总结每周回顾。

工程经理、人事/HR 经理、团队负责人和远程团队可以使用 Geekbot 提出诸如“收集团队阻碍”“监测员工敬业度”“开展状态调查”“提交我的每日更新”等请求。

此功能需要 Geekbot 付费套餐。

payload.name: PlaybookUX
payload.description: 开展并分析用户体验研究
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: PlaybookUX is a comprehensive user research platform that empowers teams to recruit, conduct, analyze, and store qualitative and quantitative research, all in one place.
payload.longDescription: PlaybookUX 是一套全面的用户研究平台，帮助团队在同一处招募参与者、开展研究、分析结果并存储定性和定量研究数据。

payload.name: UNIFIELD
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: UNIFIELD helps you turn what you want to do into a clear intent and bring it into a shared field of human intent. Instead of searching through endless content, you can directly discover matching and complementary intents from other people, projects, and opportunities, with clear explanations of why they may fit. It helps move isolated ideas and potential toward meaningful alignment.
payload.longDescription: UNIFIELD 帮助你将想做的事情明确表达为意向，并将其带入人类共同意向的共享领域。无需在海量内容中搜索，你可以直接发现其他人、项目和机会中与之匹配或互补的意向，并清楚了解它们为何可能契合。这有助于让彼此孤立的想法和潜力形成有意义的协同。

payload.name: flow - AI Collaboration tool
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: flow connects ChatGPT to your Flow (flow.team) workspace, the collaboration tool by Madrascheck. Find projects, tasks, calendar events, posts, comments, notifications, and wiki documents, and create or update work items — all scoped to the account you sign in with. Every batch write is previewed before it is applied, and irreversible changes require an explicit confirmation step.
payload.longDescription: flow 将 ChatGPT 连接到你的 Flow（flow.team）工作区，这是 Madrascheck 推出的协作工具。查找项目、任务、日历活动、帖子、评论、通知和 Wiki 文档，并创建或更新工作事项；所有操作都限于你登录的账户。每批写入操作都会在应用前显示预览，不可逆的更改必须经过明确确认。

payload.name: Inline
payload.description: 在 ChatGPT 中处理工作聊天
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Inline helps users find people and conversations, read and search scoped work chats, create threads, upload files, and send messages through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Inline 帮助用户查找人员和对话，阅读和搜索权限范围内的工作聊天，创建讨论串、上传文件，并通过 ChatGPT 发送消息。

payload.name: Front
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Front is your team's customer operations platform for email, SMS, WhatsApp and chat. Connect it to ChatGPT to work on real customer conversations.

Summarise a thread and draft a reply on its original channel. Triage an inbox by classifying requests, tagging them and assigning the right teammate. Look up a contact or account and their history before a call. See what is open and assigned to you, and what is waiting on someone else.

ChatGPT reads the full conversation timeline in one view, including customer messages, internal comments, assignments, tags and status changes, so replies and updates carry the context your team already has.

A workspace admin installs Front for the company, and each teammate authorises it individually. ChatGPT acts with exactly that teammate's Front permissions, and an admin can remove access at any time by uninstalling.
payload.longDescription:
Front 是团队用于处理电子邮件、短信、WhatsApp 和聊天的客户运营平台。将其连接到 ChatGPT，即可处理真实的客户对话。

概括对话串，并在原渠道起草回复。通过分类请求、添加标签并分配给合适的同事来分流收件箱。通话前查询联系人或账户及其历史记录。查看分配给你的待处理事项，以及正在等待他人处理的事项。

ChatGPT 会在一个视图中读取完整的对话时间线，包括客户消息、内部评论、分配情况、标签和状态变更，因此回复和更新能保留团队已有的上下文。

工作区管理员为公司安装 Front，每位团队成员再分别授权。ChatGPT 严格按照该成员在 Front 中的权限操作；管理员随时可以通过卸载来撤销访问权限。

payload.name: House of Prayer by Melorna
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: House of Prayer by Melorna is a collaborative Christian prayer network inside ChatGPT. People can anonymously request prayer, carry another person's prayer, review their own activity, and read or share moderated answered-prayer testimonies. Identity and contact details are never exposed, and content is previewed before any confirmed submission.
payload.longDescription: House of Prayer by Melorna 是 ChatGPT 内的基督教协作祷告网络。用户可以匿名提出祷告请求、为他人的祷告代祷、查看自己的活动记录，并阅读或分享经过审核的蒙应允祷告见证。身份和联系方式不会公开；任何提交得到确认前，内容都会先供预览。

payload.name: LMGram
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: LMGram helps ChatGPT turn a user's explicit intent into opt-in human match requests. Users can connect their LMGram profile, create a minimized match request, review recent incoming or outgoing requests, start a lightweight chat when both sides are interested, and send or read messages in that private LMGram chat. The app is designed for finding collaborators, peers, mentors, helpers, beta testers, or domain experts without sharing raw transcripts or unnecessary private context.
payload.longDescription: LMGram 帮助 ChatGPT 根据用户明确表达的意向，发起由用户选择加入的真人匹配请求。用户可以关联 LMGram 个人资料、创建精简的匹配请求、查看近期收到或发出的请求；双方都感兴趣时，可以开始轻量聊天，并在私密的 LMGram 聊天中收发消息。该应用旨在帮助寻找合作者、同行、导师、帮手、测试用户或领域专家，同时避免分享原始对话记录或不必要的私人背景信息。

payload.name: EasyReply
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: EasyReply is a customer support platform
payload.longDescription: EasyReply 是一个客户支持平台。

payload.name: Webex
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Webex Suite helps users manage Webex meetings, messages, spaces, memberships, files, and webhooks, and search or retrieve Vidcast videos, transcripts, and highlights.
payload.longDescription: Webex Suite 帮助用户管理 Webex 会议、消息、空间、成员关系、文件和 webhook，并搜索或检索 Vidcast 视频、转录文本和精彩片段。

payload.name: Tella
payload.description: 使用 AI 创建和编辑视频
payload.summaryOriginal: Create and edit videos with AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Tella is an all-in-one screen recorder and AI video editor for creating polished product demos, tutorials, courses, and video messages, then sharing them with a link or exporting in up to 4K.
payload.longDescription: Tella 是一款一体化屏幕录制工具和 AI 视频编辑器，可用于制作精致的产品演示、教程、课程和视频消息，然后通过链接分享或导出最高 4K 分辨率的视频。

payload.name: GoProfiles
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
GoProfiles helps teams get to know each other, celebrate wins, and stay connected by turning your company directory into a searchable, conversational people platform.

With the GoProfiles app for ChatGPT, employees can search their company's employee directory, pull up rich coworker profiles, and get the context they need to collaborate without leaving ChatGPT.

Ask ChatGPT to find someone by name, role, or team, look up a colleague's background and profile, check who's celebrating a birthday, work anniversary, or new hire milestone this week, see a coworker's availability, schedule a meeting with them, or give a Bravo to recognize great work.

GoProfiles makes it easier for teams to build genuine connections and cultivate a culture of appreciation. Instead of digging through spreadsheets or asking around, employees can simply ask ChatGPT to find the right person, celebrate the right moment, or say thanks in the right way.

Use GoProfiles in ChatGPT to strengthen team culture, reduce time spent searching for people, and give your team a faster way to recognize and connect with each other.
payload.longDescription:

payload.name: Mailbox MCP
payload.summaryOriginal: Read, send and file your email
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Mailbox MCP connects ChatGPT to a mailbox you already own, on Microsoft 365, Gmail, or any IMAP host. There is no new address and nothing to migrate.

People often ask how to connect ChatGPT to Outlook. The distinction that matters is this: it does not drive the Outlook application on your computer. It opens the same mailbox Outlook opens, on the server. So it works whether Outlook is running or not, from any device, and it works the same way whether your mail lives on Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Gmail, or a hosting company's IMAP server.

It can triage what has arrived and say what actually needs you, search across folders, read a whole thread in order, read what is inside an attachment (an invoice total, a spreadsheet, a scanned letter), draft a reply for you to check before it goes, send, forward with the original attachments intact, flag, archive, report junk, and file messages into folders. It can look up someone you have written to before, tell you whether a message bounced and whether that bounce was permanent, and check the SPF, DKIM, DMARC and MX records for your own domain.

Your address book comes with the mailbox: Outlook contacts on Microsoft 365, or a CardDAV book on any host that offers one. It can find a person, read their card with the postal address and postcode, add and correct contacts, and import a contacts file. Mailboxes on Microsoft 365, and any host offering CalDAV, get calendar tools on the same connection: read and search the diary, create and update events, check who is free, find a meeting time, send and answer invitations, and set an out of office reply. Which tools appear is measured against your servers when you connect, so you are never offered one they could not honour.

Every connection carries a permission level you choose at approval: read only, draft and file, or send and delete. A shared mailbox can be worked by a team: claim a message so colleagues see who has it, hand one to a named person, and hold a draft for the owner's approval before it is sent.

It is built so the mailbox is left exactly as you would have left it yourself. Replies carry the threading headers, so they nest inside the conversation in the recipient's client rather than starting a new one. Reading a message does not mark it as read. Exactly one copy of anything sent is filed in Sent. Moving a message keeps its flags and its original date. Nothing you read is stored: mail, calendar and contact content passes through the server in memory and is never written down.

Destructive actions are labelled as destructive, and it refuses rather than guesses. It will not delete a folder that still holds messages, and it stops to ask before replying to an address that differs from the visible sender. The company behind it, BSolve IT Limited, holds Cyber Essentials certification.
payload.longDescription:
Mailbox MCP 将 ChatGPT 连接到你已有的邮箱，可以是 Microsoft 365、Gmail 或任何 IMAP 服务商提供的邮箱。无需新建邮箱地址，也无需迁移任何内容。

人们常问如何将 ChatGPT 连接到 Outlook。关键区别在于：它不会操控电脑上的 Outlook 应用，而是在服务器上打开 Outlook 所访问的同一个邮箱。因此，无论 Outlook 是否运行，都能从任何设备使用；无论邮件存放在 Microsoft 365、Google Workspace、Gmail，还是托管服务商的 IMAP 服务器上，使用方式都一样。

它可以分拣新收到的邮件，指出哪些确实需要你处理；跨文件夹搜索；按顺序阅读完整邮件讨论串；读取附件内容（发票总额、电子表格、扫描信件）；起草回复供你在发送前检查；发送邮件；保留原附件进行转发；标记、归档、举报垃圾邮件，以及将邮件归入文件夹。它还可以查找你曾写信联系过的人，告知邮件是否被退回以及是否属于永久退信，并检查你自己域名的 SPF、DKIM、DMARC 和 MX 记录。

通讯录随邮箱一同接入：Microsoft 365 上的 Outlook 联系人，或任何支持 CardDAV 的服务商所提供的通讯录。它可以查找人员，读取包含邮寄地址和邮政编码的联系人名片，添加及修正联系人，并导入联系人文件。Microsoft 365 邮箱，以及任何支持 CalDAV 的服务商，都可以通过同一连接使用日历工具：读取和搜索日程，创建及更新日程事项，查看谁有空，寻找会议时间，发送及回复邀请，并设置外出自动回复。连接时会根据你的服务器检查可用工具，因此不会向你提供服务器无法执行的工具。

每个连接都采用你在授权时选择的权限级别：只读、起草及归档，或发送及删除。团队可以共同处理共享邮箱：认领邮件，让同事知道由谁处理；将邮件交给指定人员；或保留草稿，待所有者批准后再发送。

它的设计目标是让邮箱保持在与你亲自操作时完全相同的状态。回复会保留邮件线程头信息，因此会在收件人的邮件客户端中归入原对话，而不会新建对话。阅读邮件不会将其标记为已读。每封发送的邮件在“已发送”中只保存一份。移动邮件会保留其标记和原始日期。读取的内容不会被存储：邮件、日历和联系人内容只在服务器内存中流转，绝不会写入存储。

破坏性操作会明确标注；遇到不确定情况，它会拒绝操作，不会猜测。它不会删除仍包含邮件的文件夹；若回复地址与可见发件人不同，也会先停下来询问。其背后的公司 BSolve IT Limited 已获得 Cyber Essentials 认证。

payload.name: Never Boring AI
payload.description: 在 LinkedIn 帖子中查找陈词滥调
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Paste a LinkedIn post and see which rhetorical formulas readers have seen too often.

The plugin counts a small set of formulas and compares each count with a reference corpus of published LinkedIn posts in the same language. For every formula, it reports the value found, how the post compares with the reference posts and, when a formula is used more than usual, a concrete suggestion to say the same thing more directly.

French and English, and it says which one it measured. French carries three formulas: the "ce n'est pas X, c'est Y" contrast, three lines in a row opening on the same word, and the announced lesson ("Résultat :"). English carries one, the "it's not X, it's Y" contrast: the other two were measured on English posts and were not reliable, so they are left out.

It is a style check only. It does not rewrite the post, and it does not assess who wrote it or how it was produced. No account needed.
payload.longDescription:
粘贴一篇 LinkedIn 帖子，查看读者已经看腻了哪些修辞套路。

该插件会统计一小组修辞套路，并将每项统计结果与同一语言的 LinkedIn 已发布帖子参考语料进行比较。它会报告每种套路的出现次数、该帖与参考帖子的对比情况；如果某种套路的使用频率高于常见水平，还会给出具体建议，帮助你更直接地表达相同意思。

支持法语和英语，并会说明实际检测的语言。法语检测三种套路：“这不是 X，而是 Y”的对比句式、连续三行以相同词语开头，以及预告式结论（“Résultat :”）。英语检测一种套路：“it’s not X, it’s Y”的对比句式；另外两种也曾在英语帖子中检测，但结果不可靠，因此不纳入。

这只是风格检查。它不会改写帖子，也不会评估作者身份或帖子是如何生成的。无需账户。
